name: What types of bathtubs are available for replacement?

mainEntity.name: What types of bathtubs are available for replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is a wide range of bathtub types available for replacement, each with distinct features and benefits. Common options include acrylic, known for being lightweight and affordable; fiberglass, which is similar but less durable; cast iron, prized for its heat retention and classic look; and steel enamel, a more budget-friendly alternative to cast iron. Other choices include cultured marble or stone resin for a luxurious feel, or walk-in tubs for accessibility. Your choice depends on your budget, style preferences, and desired functionality.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bathtub types include acrylic, fiberglass, cast iron, steel enamel, cultured marble, and walk-in tubs, each with unique features.
